name: SENTANTE
versions: single platform; CE mark reported 2026-05-22; commercial rollout announced 2026-08-20 (unite.ai only, lower certainty)
target_anatomy: peripheral, visceral; vertebral stenting in pigs; stroke thrombectomy shown on cadaver models (press)
devices_driven: 3 coaxial: one guidewire 0.014-0.035 in + two over-the-wire catheters 2-8 Fr; standard off-the-shelf devices
translation_detail: other: paired sterile cassettes grip device and travel on rails
force_sensing: yes: bedside unit measures manipulation force
haptics_leader: yes: leader uses real catheter/guidewire at workstation, reflects measured force
validation_detail: ESSENTIAL first-in-human started July 2024, Paula Stradins hospital Riga (press; NCT06537947); 6 pigs; 24 GLP remote animal procedures and transatlantic cadaver thrombectomy (press)
key_numbers: pig study: no angiographic vessel injury; minimal trauma 3/16 vessels at necropsy (huistra2026_evaluation abstract). ESSENTIAL: 100% technical success, 0 device complications (unite.ai, unverified press).
